secrets.name: THE_ODDS_API_KEY
secrets.description: The Odds API key (theoddsapi.com dashboard, free tier available) — multi-book odds that the whole engine runs on. Without it odds ingestion stays idle, no games are stored, and the picks pages are empty.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com) — the AI analyst that filters value bets and the customer support chat. Without it the engine passes bets through unfiltered and support chat replies with its fallback message.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key (resend.com) — password-reset email. Without it resets are accepted and answered identically, but no mail is delivered.
